knimeNode.name: Mutation
knimeNode.shortDescription: Applies ordinary or Differential Evolution mutation.

fullDescription.intro: Automatically reads decision variables, bounds, objectives, and constraints from Problem Setup. Provides polynomial, Gaussian, random-reset, bit-flip, DE/rand/1, DE/best/1, current-to-best/1, and current-to-pbest/1 mutation. DE strategies consume donor information prepared by Selection and can use fixed, jDE, or SHADE-adapted F and CR values without a separate adaptation node.

ports.inPort: Ordinary candidates or DE target/donor bundles.
ports.outPort: Unevaluated mutants carrying the chosen DE crossover rate when applicable.
